verdict.rationale:
Vanta documents a broad Manage Vanta API covering many UI workflows:
- documents, policies and evidence, including uploading files and submitting them for review
- creating custom controls, adding library controls, mapping documents and assigning owners
- listing tests and pushing custom resources
- contracts and business units
- Customer Trust questionnaire responses
- an Auditor API with SDKs

Webhooks and an official MCP server that calls the API also ship. However, no evidence claims full UI parity, and several major product areas show no API coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or full endpoint inventory; API coverage for TPRM/vendor management, access reviews, risk register, Trust Center, framework customization and AI Agent features; independent corroboration of parity.
